verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single first-party marketing claim that marketers can 'see which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue,' which suggests some per-email conversion attribution. Nothing in the pack documents open, click, or unsubscribe reporting. missing for 10: documented open/click/unsubscribe metrics, per-campaign reporting, per-workflow-step analytics, time-series views, analytics API or docs depth, independent corroboration.
